notes: Live Shopify store (theme with a custom faceted search app). No Claude-specific robots.txt disallow (checked). Tree built from the mega-menu accordion (#furniture-accordion, 9 top-level furniture groups: Sofa, Chair/Stool, Table/Desk, TV Stand/Living Storage, Dining/Kitchen Storage, Bed/Mattress, Bedroom Storage, Bookshelf/Shelf/Rack, SOHO Office) UNION the deeper facet/category panel embedded in each collection page's own filter sidebar (class c-products-search-filters__checkbox-wrapper) -- this facet panel is what the brief's trap #1 warns about: the mega-menu under-reports the tree. CRITICAL FINDING: this facet panel is NOT a clean parent->child list -- it mixes genuine children of the current collection with cross-listed 'related' items that actually belong to a DIFFERENT parent (e.g. 'Ottoman' appears in both Sofa's and Chair/Stool's facet panels but its true parent, verified via the server-rendered breadcrumb nav (schema.org BreadcrumbList, present in raw HTML even though the product-count is client-rendered and NOT in raw HTML), is Sofa only; 'Shelf', 'Wall-Mounted Furniture', 'Wooden Shelf/Rack', 'Open Shelf' all cross-list under Chair/Stool and/or Table and/or Bed but their true single parent is Bookshelf/Shelf/Rack; 'TV Stand' cross-lists under Bedroom Storage but its true parent is TV Stand/Living Storage; 'Side Table/Night Table' cross-lists under Table but its true parent is actually Bedroom Storage; 'Office Desk' and 'Office Chair' cross-list under Table and Chair/Stool respectively but their true parent is SOHO; 'Magazine Rack' cross-lists under Table and Bookshelf/Rack but its true breadcrumb parent is a different top-level department entirely (Storage/Clothing Storage > Interior Storage), so it was excluded as out-of-scope storage, not furniture. Every multi-parent-listed handle was resolved by fetching the collection's own page and reading its server-rendered breadcrumb; single-listed handles were trusted (spot-checks on several confirmed 100% accuracy for single-listed handles). Five facet entries were DEAD LINKS (site bug: listed in the filter UI but the collection page 404s) and were dropped entirely, not emitted as rows: folding_desk, low_table (both claimed as Table children), fabric_sofa (claimed Sofa child), cabinet, living_board (both claimed Living Storage children). qty for every leaf = exhaustive unique product-ID count via /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 pagination (same-origin fetch from the loaded page), corroborated against the rendered '検索結果 N 件' header for a sample (Sofa: header 237 = json 237 exact; Table: header 135 vs json 137, a 2-item/1.5% gap likely from a small set of catalog-only SKUs not shown on the storefront listing -- used the rendered header as authoritative per Rule 1 where both were checked, json pagination count used everywhere else since it is the only source obtainable without a full-render navigation per node). EXCLUSIONS applied: Mattress (マットレス, under Bed/Mattress) dropped as bedding per brief; the parent 'Bed/Mattress' (ベッド・マットレス) node itself is flagged per brief's 'Beds & Mattresses with no split' rule since the site does not split Beds from Mattresses at the top level even though Mattress has its own child node. 'Wall-mount Hook/Hardware' (壁掛けフック・金具, 1 item, a wall hook) dropped as hardware, matching the prior Home-Decor pass's identical precedent for a wall-mount hook. 'Hanger' (ハンガー, 6 items, one-touch multi-hook cascading hangers) dropped as a closet/wardrobe organizer accessory, not standalone furniture (distinct from 'Coat Hanger' コートハンガー, which are genuine freestanding coat-stand furniture pieces and were kept). 'Magazine Rack' (マガジンラック) dropped -- its true breadcrumb parent is the site's Storage/Clothing-Storage department, not Furniture, despite being cross-listed in Table's and Bookshelf's facet panels. Sitemap (sitemap_collections_1/2.xml, 2590 total <loc> entries) was scanned via keyword regex as a second check; it surfaced the same handles already found via the facet panels (dining_table, coffee-table-family handles, etc.) plus many marketing/seasonal 'collection' pages (25aw-catalog-*, furniture-collection-*, ranking-*, finder_*) which were excluded per the brief's never-extract list (rankings/finders/seasonal catalogs are not real categories). Franc franc's own 'すべての家具' (All Furniture) catch-all and 'すべての家電・照明' catch-alls were excluded as View-All pages per brief section 3.
